unreplied.preview: We here

Tekuam appears as a tall and thin human in hide armor. Their skin is tanned like they spend a lot of time outside with long dark hair they enjoy braiding into different designs. Together with their Leshy familiar Tree Twig, they protect the wilder areas in and around the city. You may find them sleeping in trees, selling the occasional trinket made of woven vines and grass, or visiting temples of various mortal born gods

Steele nods at the newcomer. "Sergeant Steele here."

Steele is an androgynous looking humanoid with white fur on her face and body, and blackish nostrils like a wolf, but otherwise a humanoid face. She's in the polished steel breast plate of a Magnimar City Guard, although there are strange black trails staining her face, like tearstains, beside the red paint surrounding her eyes.
[media]

A strange Aiuverian man comes running in with a bow and arrow drawn. He's a bit nervous and says "Z-Zal reporting for duty!" He has an average height but is somewhat thin, he is wearing a fancy looking shirt and pants, blue with a silver trim and silver buttons. He has spent his life excelling at doing what he is told and being where he should be, but now that he is outside of a classroom or a debutant ball he looks and feels hopelessly out of place. On his back is a quiver that holds down a thi
he is currently pointing his bow straight downward while catching his breath

*Tekuam walks up, followed by a small Leshy, to the meeting seeing other guards standing around. They look mildly perturbed they were woken up from a nap in a tree* "The higher ups do know this is out of my area of expertise, but they needed someone with actual charisma down here. I wouldn't mind taking a look at some of those traps either."

Not long after Zalaralith arrives, Avelik shows up on scene as well. A lightly armored unremarkable human man with a slightly armored coat covering most of his outfit. He smiles widely and offers a jovial "Hello!" with too much enthusiasm and not enough introduction.
*Tekuam gives the golem a pat on the back* "Very informative, thank you"

A rather sinewy, beautiful woman slithers in after those first two guards. She has green slitted snake eyes, and long wild, black hair dangling down her back. As you follow the hair down her body, you see how her torso connects to a green snakes lower half. A symbol of Callistria dangles loose from her neck, and a backpack has a rather large shield dangling from it. Inclining her head, she hissed: “Tasivata Scalescrape ready for duty”.

Strolling into the room is a rather average looking human with the exception of eyes and hair that look like they are made from pure gold. Dressed in a pressed cloths under a long jacket with stiff leather pieces with metallic studs, a rapier belted on one hip and a tome on the other. He looks around and heads to the guard in charge and in a melodic voice akin to a heavenly host says "I hear your looking for investigators",after which he pulls out a small card and ands it to the guard. "Hemlock
"At ease, Zal."
"At ease, Tasivata," Steele's voice sounds slightly surprised at her lower body, but it barely changes her register for a fraction of a second.
"I am Sergeant Steele, and that is Changer. Once we've gathered ourselves, we will continue forward."
If there seems to be a wait for backup, the diminutive detective begins to contemplate. Calculate. (Refocus)

"Alright, that everyone?"

Nadya taps her smoking pipe empty against her leg and ambles towards the group.

"Hey kids, welcome to the zoo. I'm your chirurgeon. Keep me alive by running in first, and I'll pick you back up. If you're on the clock and you want elixirs or drugs, you talk to me. Any questions before we continue?"

"I'm sorry," a soft, almost weak voice is heard. "that I took so long."

Out came a tall, imposing man covered in an enormous amount of clothes, the muffled sound of labored breathing and metal armor jostling around closely following him. He is clad in robes of white and gold, with belts of red leather and brassy buckles holding his clothes tightly around his armor; the only portion of his armor that wasn't covered was that of his left arm—with which hand he gently held against his chest as he w
[media]

"Hells. Fine. You holy god-loving folks just keep away from me with your magic, and we'll be square."

Nadya stands back and gives each newcomer an appraising look. 

"Zal. Pleasure to meet. Let me know if you need some practical advice, I've been working... a while."

"Tekuam, Nadya. Same goes for you, I suppose. Don't be shy."

To Avelik, Nadya seems amused at the enthusiasm and just greets him with a simple "Hey kid. Don't go running off alone quite yet, okay?"

"Tasivata..." Nadya draws out

Avelik smiles wide and bright at the advice. A simpleton's chuckle escapes through the hand he brings up to cover his mouth. He clears his throat to fix his attitude.

"Thank you Nadya. OH! I should introduce myself proper now that I'm here! I'm Avelik Granoborn, archeologist and aspiring investigator. Pleased to meet you all!"

His attention is pulled between everyone and each person gets a second of a glance as he speaks. He swivels his head so often while speaking that it threatens to twist o

Kitt pokes their head up and waves at the new arrivals with a cheerful smile.

"Hello everyone. Thanks for coming to help! Let me just finish wrapping this guy up so he won't bleed out while we're finishing our work. I'm Kitt by the way, from the Chaplain Unit."

"Greeting's all, we have quite the ensemble here." Investigator Tomes says. "How I've come to join is another story. Natalya you are correct it might not be the exact place for me but I owe Sgt. Alistair Lade a return favour. He helped me out of a situation I was in from my last job." as he begins talking with his hands.

"Since we are waiting might as well get it out so you all don't get the wrong idea." he says looking around. "I was investigating indiscretions of Lord Barnaby Pedantry. I had
*Tekuam walks over to Kitt* "would you like a hand with your injured person? Should be able to stop him from bleeding if nothing else"

"If someone kept you out of the hells, that puts a lot into place. Pretty common 'recruitment' tactic. Magnimar may not have too many laws, but the chelaxians up top definitely have rules the rest of us aren't supposed to break. Not too many noble toes to step on inside this construction site, but do keep the property damage down anyway if you can."

"Thanks for the offer, but I'm almost done actually. But we will probably need help later. The workers have been surprisingly resourceful in setting up traps in here."

Kitt wipes their brow causing their eyebrow piercings to lightly rings out as they get tapped by the ring on his hand. They inspect the work before grabbing one last bandage and deftly tying it onto the kobold worker's leg.

"All done!"

Staine walks up behind Kitt, briefly watching them tend to the kobold before nodding. He turns and addresses Nadya.

"Have you already established contact with the kobolds? Do we—" Staine is interrupted by a sudden fit of dry, heaving coughs. "Do we... have anyone skilled in infiltration?" He asks, looking around at the others.

A light, hissing laugh erupted from Tasivata. Gesticulating down at her heavy armour and her rather large and unusual form, "What do you think my friend? Leaning back against a wall, her tail scratched into the stone, as she looked about the rest of the party.
"We've been taking it one room at a time. As for infiltration, this isn't the kind of situation where my experience is helpful. The little bat sprite over there has been pretty quiet so far."
"I'm pretty certain there's only one way to get at the last group, though. We did some sneaking around earlier and got about as far as we could with it."
